ERRATA.ORIGINAL_STATEMENT: 'Balance controller authority is braking-only and cannot command forward CoP/Fx; forward lunge is uncorrectable in principle'; reproduction text: 'com_vx accelerates 0.181 -> 0.342 m/s after touchdown while the controller can only brake'. The phrase 'uncorrectable in principle' overstates the authority loss.
ERRATA.CORRECTED_STATEMENT: The live balance outer law is one-sided but not inert. Verified from source: FX_BRAKE_MIN = -120.0 < 0 and FX_BRAKE_MAX = 0.0, and Fx_raw = -px/T_rem (px = MASS*cv[0]). For vx > 0 the raw demand is negative and inside [-120, 0], so the controller CAN command braking Fx < 0; at the R001 peak (vx = 0.34183 m/s) the raw demand -120.27 N saturates the -120 N bound. The one-sided set cannot command positive Fx, so it cannot regulate symmetrically through zero or command the opposite correction after overshoot. R001 trend: vx 0.18142 (E9) -> 0.34183 peak (t=1.0385) -> crosses zero at 1.601125 -> minimum -0.058181 (t=2.117) -> final -0.001276 m/s. Conclusion: 'horizontal/CAM authority is one-sided; it can brake the initially positive forward state but cannot regulate symmetrically through zero or command the opposite correction after overshoot.'
ERRATA.REPRODUCTION_METHOD: Read balance_capture.py source and canonical_runtime.py dispatch (BALANCE = BalanceController); recomputed COM vx from sealed diagnostics/traj_metrics.npz; computed Fx_raw at the post-touchdown peak with MASS=95.0, T_BAL=0.27.
ERRATA.R001_DISPOSITION_EFFECT: NONE — R001 remains physical-visual credibility FAIL and ship BLOCKED.
ERRATA.CLAIM_EFFECT: HIGH-003 must be cited as one-sided (half-plane) authority with no symmetric zero-crossing regulation; the 'cannot brake forward motion' / 'uncorrectable in principle' wording is withdrawn. Severity unchanged because asymmetric authority remains a genuine control-authority defect and R001 exhibits an uncorrected negative-velocity overshoot.
